reason: This research gap aims to determine if there is an elevated rate of Sudden Unexpected Infant Death (SUID) among infants whose mothers experienced severe mental health issues during pregnancy compared to those who did not. The design uses the case series (ncfrp_v51) for numerator and population reference sources (prams_p8_arf, prams_p7_arf) to assess maternal mental health status during pregnancy, with live birth denominators from cdc_natl15.
